beats.anchor: « On dirait un mouton qui sort de chez le coiffeur », souffle Kaydoudou.
beats.extras: Coach Nathan Okafor, 38: a British Nigerian man with a shaved head, very broad shoulders, a black tracksuit, a marker in his hand, standing proudly beside his drawing with a huge grin. Freddie Shaw, 14: a very tall, gangly white English goalkeeper with copper red hair, freckles up to his eyelids and red ears, leaning sideways to whisper. A row of other teenage boys of 14 and 15 in dark green tracksuits, some white, some South Asian, some Black, trying not to laugh.
beats.outfit: BriBri (14) in the dark green Kingsbridge Albion tracksuit, the fine shaved part on the left of his head, the braided blue and white bracelet on his left wrist, his notebook covered in green and orange wax cloth half hidden under the table. Kaydoudou (13) in the same dark green tracksuit, his soft afro, the gap between his front teeth, red sock on his RIGHT foot and yellow sock on his LEFT foot.
beats.action: On the whiteboard, Okafor has drawn a very bad lion that looks like a fluffy sheep fresh from the hairdresser, with three short scribbled lines underneath. Kaydoudou leans toward his brother, a hand cupped at his mouth, whispering, eyes sparkling. BriBri bites the inside of his cheek, shoulders shaking, trying not to burst out laughing. Behind them, Freddie whispers to his neighbour.
beats.location: A small video room at a London football academy: rows of chairs and narrow tables, a big whiteboard, a switched off screen, rain on the windows.
beats.light: Cool grey daylight from rainy windows mixed with warm ceiling lights, the white board bright.
beats.camera: Medium shot from the side of the second row, the brothers in the foreground, the whiteboard with Okafor and his sheep lion sharp in the background.
beats.alt: Devant le lion d'Okafor qui ressemble à un mouton, Kaydoudou chuchote une blague et BriBri se retient de rire.

beats.extras: Jaden Clarke, 15, number 4: a tall, athletic Black British boy with dark brown skin and close cropped black hair with a sharp hairline, jaw tight, chest forward, a head taller than most. Around them, a ring of teenage teammates in dark green, mouths open in a long Ooooh. Coach Okafor, a British Nigerian man with a shaved head and very broad shoulders in a black tracksuit, striding in from the background with his whistle at his lips.
beats.outfit: BriBri (14) and Jaden in the dark green Kingsbridge Albion training kit with white sleeves, BriBri number 8, Jaden number 4. BriBri's fine shaved part on the left of his head and his braided blue and white bracelet on his left wrist. Kaydoudou (13) in the background ring, red sock on his RIGHT foot, yellow sock on his LEFT foot, hands on his head.
beats.action: BriBri and Jaden stand nose to nose in the middle of the training pitch. Jaden has just taken a step forward; BriBri has not stepped back and lifts his chin slightly to look up at him, calm but with his cheeks burning. Neither blinks. Raindrops hang between their faces.
beats.location: The artificial pitch of a south London football academy on a weekday evening, cones scattered on the wet turf, a fence and the clubhouse roof behind.
beats.light: Floodlights through fine rain, a cold white rim light on both faces, the background ring of boys softer.
beats.camera: Close profile shot of the two faces facing each other across the frame, the ring of teammates and the arriving coach blurred behind.
beats.alt: Sous la pluie, BriBri et Jaden se retrouvent nez à nez, et BriBri lève le menton sans reculer.

beats.anchor: Kaydoudou, lui, mange le défenseur de repos.
beats.outfit: Papa Armand: tall, short neat beard, a light blue shirt, sleeves rolled up. Maman Estelle: braids gathered in a bun, big gold earrings, a teal and yellow wax print dress under a grey cardigan, a mug of milky tea in both hands. BriBri (14) in the dark green Kingsbridge Albion tracksuit, the fine shaved part on the left of his head, the braided blue and white bracelet on his left wrist. Kaydoudou (13) in the same dark green tracksuit, red sock on his RIGHT foot, yellow sock on his LEFT foot, the gap between his front teeth.
beats.action: Around the small kitchen table, BriBri explains pressing with the dinner: one finger pushes the salt shaker toward Maman's plate while four green peas roll forward together. Papa leans in, very interested, chin on his fist. Maman looks over her mug with raised eyebrows. And Kaydoudou, with an innocent face, is popping one of the peas that was supposed to stay back into his mouth.
beats.location: A cramped kitchen in a narrow terraced house in Lewisham, south London: a small table with plates of rice and peas, a little pot of red chilli sauce, a teapot, rain streaking the dark window.
beats.light: Warm yellow lamp light over the table, cosy against the blue rainy night outside.
beats.camera: Medium shot from slightly above the table, the salt shaker and rolling peas in the foreground, the four faces around it.
beats.alt: Au dîner, BriBri explique le pressing avec la salière et les petits pois, et Kaydoudou mange le défenseur de repos.
